text:
Sofia Lee: Quick SIG follow-up from Northfield Bank. They want question-level evidence for Q12 (transport encryption), Q19 (KMS lifecycle/BYOK), and Q41 (access reviews). Deadline tomorrow morning ET.

Owen Walsh: I can grab TLS termination screenshot and the envoy mTLS policy for inter-service traffic. Will redact IPs.

Priyanka Desai: I'll handle KMS artifacts. They asked specifically: proof of rotation in last 90 days + BYOK onboarding doc + example key policy.

Sofia Lee: For Q41 they want a sample quarterly access review report and a short statement about our IAM review cadence. Who owns that?

Owen Walsh: Security team usually runs access reviews; I have an anonymized report we can export (no usernames, just roles and review decisions).

Priyanka Desai: Running rotation query now (GCP example):
```
# sample: find rotation events
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName:cryptoKeyVersions.rotate" --freshness=90d --format="csv(timestamp,protoPayload.resourceName)"
```
Will scrub resource names and upload CSV.

Sofia Lee: Please drop everything as a single drive folder and include short one-line answers for the SIG cells. Suggested wording for Q19: "Redwood supports BYOK for Hosted in supported regions and HSM integration for Private deployments. Keys remain under customer control unless otherwise contracted; rotation is configurable and audit logged."

Owen Walsh: LGTM. Uploading LB TLS config + envoy mTLS policy + cert fingerprint.

evidence-bot: Artifacts uploaded to https://drive.redwood.internal/sig/northfield-1930/ — includes: tls-termination.png, envoy-mtls-policy.png, cert-fingerprint.txt, kms-keypolicy.json (redacted), kms-rotation-90d.csv (scrubbed), access-review-q1-2026.csv (anonymized), byok-runbook.md

Priyanka Desai: Confirmed kms-rotation-90d.csv shows rotation events on 2026-01-12 and 2026-02-28 for rotated keys (aliases redacted).

Sofia Lee: Great. I'll paste the drive link and the short answers into the SIG spreadsheet now. If they ask for signed attestation or PSO language, I'll escalate to Legal. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
